מודול אחד מיועד להתאמת הרמות של הרומבה;: One module is planned for the Roomba level interface; its supply routing still needs identification. LiDAR already uses 3.3V UART and does not use the second module. VCC and 3V3 are not GND: do not ground them or add C1–C4. The close-up shows 12 IC contacts; the RUT reference map and routing checks are in the review.
מיפוי המסילות ו־OE של NOYITO, התאמת סימ: NOYITO supply/OE routing, a 2N3904 marking matched to its datasheet, the fuse series and DC specifications, and the Roomba board revision with physical power points. Product photographs have already been reviewed; there is no need to resend the same links. Continuity and voltage checks still apply to the actual parts being assembled.
A current-limited bench supply was not found in the reviewed purchases. If none is available, remain with unpowered checks; the robot battery is not a substitute for the first test. The electrical review defines TP1–TP4 and their limits.
בדוק כל חוט מול הטבלה, משיכה עדינה, ביד: Check every wire against the table, gently tug each joint, and inspect insulation and solder debris. Measure disconnected-wire continuity against probe resistance. A beep is not a complete short-circuit test; capacitors can cause changing readings.
נתק את כל העומסים. EN ו־PG פנויים. כוון: Disconnect every load. Leave EN and PG open. With a bench supply switched off, set 12V and a 0.1A current limit, then connect positive to VIN and negative to GND. These are temporary test conditions, not battery thresholds. No robot is attached.
שחור ב־COM ואדום ב־V/Ω, מצב מתח DC. חבר: Black lead in COM, red in V/Ω, meter in DC-voltage mode. Attach insulated probes between VOUT and GND while the supply is off, then turn it on. Expect about 5V within 4.8–5.2V, allowing for instrument accuracy. Turn off and investigate sustained current limiting, an incorrect voltage or abnormal heating. Brief capacitor-charging current limiting does not alone prove a short; do not raise the limit to bypass an unexplained fault.
כבה ונתק את הספק לפני שינוי חוטים. בדיקה: Turn off and disconnect the supply before changing wires. A no-load reading does not qualify LiDAR startup voltage. The regulator’s 4% range leaves no voltage-drop margin at a 4.8V output.

נדרשים 4.8–5.2V במגעי VCC/GND תחת עומס,: VCC/GND must remain within 4.8–5.2V under load, including startup and controller activity. A multimeter checks DC; short dips and overshoots require waveform measurement. If measurement uncertainty crosses a limit, the result is not a pass. This is a qualification requirement, not an instruction to attach LiDAR now.
בצע את בדיקות D4/D5, סדר כיבוי S1 וזמן: Perform the D4/D5, S1 shutdown order and rail-rise checks in LIDAR_POWER_UART.md before operation. Wires stay connected during normal shutdown. Sequence and waveform measurements require an oscilloscope; they have not been performed.
בדיקת USB או צריבת XIAO נעשות כשהוא מנות: USB checks or flashing require XIAO to be disconnected from the entire external harness, including signals. Before S1 control, check firmware that holds D3/GPIO4 LOW at startup and reset. The full RooCoreXiao firmware now implements the sequence, including battery cutoff, and has built in two configurations. See FIRMWARE_INTEGRATION.md and VALIDATION.md. Enable settings stay false/0 until assembly qualification. No flashing or hardware test has been performed.
השלמת מיפוי NOYITO, ההגנות ונקודות הרובו: A complete system still requires NOYITO mapping, protection qualification and robot connection points. Load measurements, EN thresholds and battery rebound have not been measured. This guide does not instruct you to connect the assembly to the battery.
אין לשים מולטימטר במצב אמפר במקביל לסולל: Never place a multimeter in current mode across the battery. Never measure resistance or continuity on a powered circuit.
